purpose: Scenic 200×200 village background; interactive houses and roads remain separate.

Warm afternoon daylight from upper-left, natural delicate cast shadows, richly textured storybook realism, warm earth, desaturated lush moss and sage greens, pale weathered stone; inviting and inhabited feeling. No black framing or empty surround, image reaches all four edges. CAMERA: elevated nearly orthographic TOP-DOWN overhead battlemap, very little perspective on the playable ground, no horizon line; sculpted cliffs and landscape relief give depth around the margins, compatible with separately overlaid top-down cottage roofs. IMPORTANT: no houses, roofs, buildings, trees, water or rocks inside the central broad meadow x=50..160,y=45..155 except the small communal well; cottage houses are separate interactive objects. Environment must look like a gorgeous complete fantasy village landscape, not repetitive tiled dirt, not a barren developer prototype, no chessboard, no UI, no labels, no symbols, no watermarks.
